breaking_news.headline: What a Monopoly importer learned when it tried to make things in the U.S.A.
breaking_news.summary: After getting hit with tariffs for the imported board games he sells, Jonathan Silva decided to see if he could produce a version of his Monopoly game in the United States. This is what he learned.

breaking_news.headline: EV battery recycling has a math problem
breaking_news.summary: For some electric vehicle batteries, it costs more to recycle them than they're worth. That creates all kinds of problems, which a new Colorado law aims to solve.

breaking_news.headline: States sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros blockbuster merger
breaking_news.summary: California is among the states suing to block Paramount from buying Warner Bros. Discovery in a Hollywood mega-merger that would unite some of the nation's largest movie studios and TV newsrooms.

breaking_news.headline: 'The Trojan Teddy Bear': The promise and peril of childhood in the age of AI
breaking_news.summary: AI is moving beyond chatbots and into toys, dolls, and robots built to befriend children. A leading child-development expert says the technology offers real promise — but also risks crowding out the human relationships children need most.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation slowed sharply -- but it may not last
breaking_news.summary: Annual inflation hit 3.5% in June, down from May's more than three-year high — but the resumption of the conflict with Iran threaten to push up inflation as energy costs once again spike.

breaking_news.headline: Mystery bidder buys T. rex nicknamed 'Gus' for a record $50 million
breaking_news.summary: A Tyrannosaurus rex fossil billed as one of the world's largest and most complete specimens was sold for a record $50.1 million Tuesday to a mystery bidder.

breaking_news.headline: American AI is expensive. Some startups are turning to cheap Chinese models
breaking_news.summary: AI is a fast-growing business expense. Some companies are cutting costs by switching to cheaper Chinese AI models.

breaking_news.headline: China's economy grows 4.3% in Q2, slowest since late 2022
breaking_news.summary: Lagging consumer spending and business investment offset the boost from strong exports thanks partly to the boom in artificial intelligence.

breaking_news.headline: Venezuela government to launch formal talks with opposition members
breaking_news.summary: The opposition says the aim of the talks is to strengthen the democratic institutions and the electoral system.

breaking_news.headline: Rastafarians in Kenya fail in bid to get cannabis legalised for religious purposes
breaking_news.summary: The court acknowledged the need for a broader national debate on cannabis policy in Kenya.

breaking_news.headline: Italy's Meloni suffers surprise setback in close vote on electoral reform
breaking_news.summary: The defeat triggered opposition calls for Meloni to resign ahead of next year's general election.

breaking_news.headline: Russian attacks kill eight as Ukraine hits Black Sea oil tankers
breaking_news.summary: Civilian casualties are reported in four Ukrainian regions, while Kyiv hits 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea.

breaking_news.headline: Strait of Hormuz 'faultline' exposes weakness of the US-Iran deal
breaking_news.summary: Control of the waterway has become a key point of contention between the US and Iran, as a ceasefire deal falters.

breaking_news.headline: Trump retreat over Hormuz tolls suggests he is struggling to end Iran war
breaking_news.summary: The abrupt about-face from the US president was the latest twist in a conflict that has now lasted more than four months.

breaking_news.headline: Iran threatens to block more trade routes as US launches fresh strikes
breaking_news.summary: US President Donald Trump vowed to strike Iran's bridges and power plants next week if the country does not return to talks.

breaking_news.headline: China economic growth falls sharply, missing target
breaking_news.summary: Weak demand domestically and the impact of the Iran war on oil prices overshadowed the country's strong exports.

breaking_news.headline: I changed jobs 10 times in 10 years to get the career I wanted
breaking_news.summary: The lily-padding trend sees young people repeatedly move jobs to try to advance in the workplace.

breaking_news.headline: Midnight social media curfew proposed for UK teens aged 16 and 17
breaking_news.summary: The government says it will improve teenagers' lives but campaigners call it a "missed opportunity".

breaking_news.headline: Easyjet passengers stuck on tarmac for hours when plane couldn't refuel
breaking_news.summary: One passenger said she only got home at 06:00 after being stuck on the runway in the middle of the night.

breaking_news.headline: How will Buy Now Pay Later changes affect you?
